name: Bank Operation
definition: Operation on a bank account. It may be limited in time, amount or type of operation.

OperationThreshold.name: Operation Threshold
OperationThreshold.definition: Threshold related to a bank account operation.

OperationType.name: Operation Type
OperationType.definition: Specifies the type of the operation related to a bank account.

ApplicablePeriod.name: Applicable Period
ApplicablePeriod.definition: Specifies the period, for instance a number of days, for which the bank operations are permitted.
